measurementIntegrity.note: Verified before packaging version metadata is advanced. Release preview.4 contains the same measured C# algorithms; packaging informational versions and binary hashes change. Raw manifests identify the measured binaries.

Limitations: Per-frame managed allocations only; native/driver allocations not counted.
Process memory includes runtime, Vulkan driver mappings and earlier workloads.
P95 is individual frame latency; table time is median of batch means.
CPU utilization is process TotalProcessorTime over wall clock, normalized to one logical core.
Each frame includes full GPU round-trip: command record, submit, fence wait and host readback copy.
Fixed scenes reuse texture/caches across frames; -changing scenes force coverage misses.
Quality gate compares against the original's GPU output as ground truth.

beforeManifest.SourceNote: Frozen managed runtime supplied explicitly; RuntimeSha256 identifies the measured binaries. ProductSourceSha256 records the workspace and is not a claim that it built the frozen runtime.

afterManifest.SourceNote: Measured managed runtime built from the recorded workspace source.

frozenRuntime.note: Freshly built unchanged benchmark/compatibility worker (0.1 assembly references); engine assemblies restored from the frozen before desktop runtime. The earlier v1 copy had a stale 1.0 compatibility shim and failed to start; no v1 performance data is used.

api.BinaryCompatibility: Not established: assembly identity and strong-name signing differ; signature matches alone do not prove binary compatibility.
api.Limitations: Public metadata only; protected APIs, attributes not listed by this tool, nullable annotations, and behavioral contracts require additional review.
